summary: BOXABL Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Third Amendment to its merger agreement with SPAC FG Merger II Corp. and Merger Sub. The amendment revises lock-up terms for company and sponsor shares: company lock-up releases 50% at six months if price ≥$12.00 for 20/30 days, remaining at 13 months, with full early release at $20.00; sponsor lock-up releases 50% at earlier of 12 months or $12.00 condition, remainder at 12 months. No deal price or premium was changed. The transaction is a SPAC de-SPAC merger. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory approval timeline.
